}}'''Varil Nensen''' is an [[Asha'man]] Soldier from [[Tarabon]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Varil Nensen}}

== Appearance ==
He is young with dark eyes and thick mustaches covered by a transparent veil.

== Activities ==
When he was a Soldier Asha'man and Rand vaguely remembers seeing him when he was handing out the first silver sword and dragon pins.

During the war in northern Altara, he fights in the battle against the [[Seanchan]]; during the campaign Nensen makes a report outside [[Illian]] to [[Rand al'Thor]]: the enemy troops are thirty miles west of them during their skirmishes.

He has gone back to reside in the [[Black Tower]] and is now one of [[Mazrim Taim]]'s special students. He has improved out of sight with use of the [[One Power]] since taking the special lessons and has been promoted to Asha'man.

At the [[Last Battle]], he has been [[Bonding|bonded]] by [[Alviarin Freidhen]], and fights alongside her and several other of Taim's lackeys and [[Black Ajah|Black]] sisters. Through a cleverly designed trap, Nensen, Alviarin and the others are tricked by [[Androl Genhald]] and [[Pevara Tazanovni]] into entering [[Stedding Sholoon]], where they are taken captive by the [[Ogier]] residents.

He is presumed to be alive and a captive of Stedding Sholoon.
